cohort: 15,295 women who delivered at a tertiary level hospital in Pretoria, South Africa between January 1, 2014 and December 31, 2018
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 55%, with Robson's 10 Group 5 (multiparous women with previous caesarean section, singleton pregnancy at ≥37 weeks) being the largest contributor (29%), and no statistically significant difference in postpartum hemorrhage rate between vaginal and caesarean deliveries.
